headline: Fisherman's Row and Godcrofts Flare as Center Fronts Grind
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, major movement has shifted sharply back to the maritime theater, where Fisherman's Row reignited with six strategic base transitions logged across Dankana Post and Peripti Landing in the last two hours. Action also flared in Godcrofts, where two recent outpost shifts left Lipsia neutralized amidst renewed island contention. In contrast, the rapid base captures previously reported in the Dead Lands and Lykos Isle have paused over the past two hours, though attritional pressure remains fierce; Dead Lands alone absorbed over twenty-seven hundred casualties in that brief window. Massive grinding clashes persist along static sectors, with Weathered Expanse suffering more than two thousand casualties across unbroken lines in the two-hour span. Meanwhile, heavy localized fighting continues across King's Cage, Loch Mor, and Stlican Shelf, where high infantry turnover persists without immediate shifts in territory.
